# How Clinic Assistant/Doctor Can View Patient’s Past Visits


This article explains how Clinic Assistants or Doctors can check a patient’s visit history in the system.


---


## Steps


1.


From **Registration** or **Consultation** tab, open the **All** tab.


2.


Click the **Search** icon (located beside the *Register* button).


3.


Enter the patient’s **IC / Name / Phone number** .


4.


The search results will appear.


5.


Click on any of the listed **visit dates** to view full visit details.


✅ You can now review the patient’s past consultations and records easily.
